newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.

LIVE CATTLE - 0.10 to 0.15 cent lower. There appears to be growing concern about slow movement of beef following the recent run-up in prices. USDA reported only 138 fabricated loads of boxed beef traded Monday. Many also revising down their expectations for cash trade this week, looking for it to develop at a steady $66 per cwt, rather than up $1 at $67.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. Overnight losses in CBOT corn futures may help to offset any spillover weakness from live cattle pit.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.10 cent. Cash hogs seen steady to $0.50 per cwt higher Tuesday. Product prices also continue to firm following recent light kills.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to 0.250 cent. Cash fresh pork belly market remains firm. There were no deliveries posted against the August contract.
